label: sub_033_ecology_02
text: Thanks for taking on all those Tera Raid Battles\nfor us![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sub_033_ecology_03
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Our investigation is moving along thanks to you,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]—we have some new data.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sub_033_ecology_04
text: It seems that Terastal energy is released from\nthe Great Crater of Paldea from time to time,\r\nand that’s having an effect on the crystals.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sub_033_ecology_05
text: Tera Raid crystals that get hit by especially strong\nblasts of this energy are apparently transforming\r\ninto [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]black crystals[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sub_033_ecology_06
text: The Tera Pokémon found at these black crystals\nare incredibly powerful...[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sub_033_ecology_07
text: So much so that average Trainers wouldn’t stand\na chance against them.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sub_033_ecology_08
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]You’re anything but average, but I’m afraid this is\ntoo dangerous—even for you,\r\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sub_033_ecology_09
text: Even if you find the location of one of these\nblack crystals on your map app, please do NOT—\r\nI repeat—DO NOT take on the Tera Raid there![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sub_033_ecology_10
text: Hmmm... You almost seem a little TOO willing to\nagree.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sub_033_ecology_11
text: I mean it! Don’t read into that like there’s some\nkind of hidden meaning![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sub_033_ecology_12
text:
Sorry for getting you involved in this only to ask
you to step away, but...\c
Whatever you do, do NOT go looking for these
black crystals![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sub_033_ecology_13
text: I’m counting on you to make the right choice\nhere![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
